en.html:
Tired.

The last thing holding me up was gone. Tiredness was all I could feel now.

だった。

en.html:
I dragged my heavy feet onward.

Somewhere to run to.
If possible, somewhere with nothing at all.

A voice came from behind.
It did not sound as though it meant to stop me.
en.text:
I dragged my heavy feet onward.

Somewhere to run to.
If possible, somewhere with nothing at all.

A voice came from behind.
It did not sound as though it meant to stop me.

ja.html:
重い足を引いて歩く。

　何処かの逃げ場へ。
　願わくば、何も無い場所へ。

　背後から声。
　――引き止める響きでは、なかった。

en.html: I sensed him getting up. And then—◆ The sound of a blade.
en.text:
I sensed him getting up.

And then—◆

The sound of a blade.

ja.html: 立ち上がる気配。 　そして、◆ 　刃音。
ja.text:
立ち上がる気配。

en.html:
I fell onto the cold grass.

...Ah.
Everything was going far away. Everything.

Just as I had wanted.

　……ああ。
　遠くなる。何もかも。

　望んだ通りに。

en.html:
Sorimachi"Minato..."
Sorimachi"Right to the end, you were one bloody boring fellow."

ja.html:
雪車町「湊斗……」
雪車町「てめぇは最後まで、つまらねえ奴だったよ」

en.html:
So much contempt in that voice.
Listening to it, I thought—

Arre. Who would have thought.
Not even in a dream had I imagined it.

This man could be so... kind.

侮蔑の声。
　それを聴いて思う。

　――真逆。
　夢だに考えもしなかった。

　この男が、こんな……優しい人間だったとは。
